UI_MinidoracatEconomy_ToastSeconds_toolt: How long economy notifications (sales, delists, claims...) stay on screen
UI_MinidoracatEconomy_PanelOpacity_toolt: Opacity of the economy window background; adjust it from Settings in the sidebar
UI_MinidoracatEconomy_NavCollapsedPlayer: Checked: the left navigation folds into a narrow icon rail. Unchecked: icons with words. The window's own toggle writes this same setting, and each window remembers its own.
UI_MinidoracatEconomy_NavCollapsedAdmin_: Checked: the admin window's left navigation folds into a narrow icon rail and gives the width back to the tables. Unchecked: icons with words. The title-bar toggle writes this same setting.
UI_MinidoracatEconomy_PreferencesSaveFai: Settings applied for this session, but saving ModOptions.ini failed. Check its write permissions.
